issues.issue: Did the Officer breach procedural fairness in refusing the work permit?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant alleges breaches of procedural fairness and apprehension of bias.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent argues procedural fairness standard was met and no breach occurred.
issues.result_text: Applicant failed to show any breach of procedural fairness by Officer.

issues.issue: Was the Officer's decision to refuse the work permit unreasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant submits decision was unreasonable as Officer failed to consider evidence of financial establishment in India.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent argues Officer reasonably reviewed evidence and denied application.
issues.result_text: Decision is not unreasonable after reviewing materials and submissions.
